t: This is the Goldsmith Building, in the City of London, in the EC4Y postcode. It was designed by James Piers St Aubyn, usually known as J P St Aubyn, a Victorian architect. He was best known for his church architecture and for confident restorations of older buildings. That reputation is worth keeping in mind as you look at it. A man who spent his career working on churches here designed something for a very different, city setting.
